meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 交付代码前先自己跑一遍人工验收,再让一名审查者逐项把关目标、约束、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次提 PR 前都担心漏掉验收步骤或质量问题
copy.tagline_en: Run your own manual QA, then one focused gate review before the PR handoff
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a consistent quality gate before every PR handoff.

howto.what: 装上后，当你让它审查已完成的实现时，Claude 会亲自在真实界面上跑一轮人工 QA 并留下证据，再只启动一个 gate reviewer 子代理，对照目标、约束、安全等逐项核对；QA 没有失败行且审查通过，才算过。
howto.when: 在一次 PR 交接（handoff）之前会触发；或当你明确要求审查已完成的工作时接管。

say.text: 帮我审查一下刚做完的这个改动，按 PR 交接的标准来。
先在真实界面上自己跑一遍人工 QA，把证据记下来。
say.note: 先走手动 QA 这条线。

say.text: 派一个 gate reviewer 核对目标、约束和我的 QA 证据。
say.note: 只启动一个审查子代理。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews completed work by running manual QA itself on the real surface, then launching exactly one gate reviewer to check goal, constraints, security and QA evidence. It passes only if no QA row fails and the reviewer approves.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

say_en.text: Review the change I just finished, as if for a PR handoff.
Run manual QA yourself on this page first and keep the evidence.
Launch one gate reviewer to check goal, constraints and my QA evidence.
say_en.note: Only one reviewer, not a panel.
